Class TotemPickingState

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.controller.states.ControllerState
org.adsl.server.controller.states.TotemPickingState
All Implemented Interfaces:
RequestVisitor<VirtualClient>
public class TotemPickingState extends ControllerState
Manual state in which each player picks their totem colour before the game board is initialised.

Broadcasts the list of still-available totems after each pick. Once every player has chosen a totem the state transitions to InitGameState.

If a player disconnects while totem picking is in progress the base-class visit(ClientDisconnected) sets toStop = true; the overridden calcNextState() detects this and transitions to RecoverState instead, waiting for all players to reconnect before resuming.
